title: Shonen Jump Seems Ready to Cancel Its Next Major 2026 Series
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine seems ready to cancel its next major series this year as one manga is speeding through what seems to be its final chapter as it nears the 30th chapter mark. It’s been a much better year overall for Shonen Jump when compared to last year.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll to Stream in Select Cars Through Appning by FORVIA
content: Crunchyroll announced on Wednesday that it is collaborating with the automotive apps distribution platform Appning by FORVIA to enable its service to stream in select vehicles in North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, India, and Australia.
author: ANN

title: One Piece Just Turned Luffy Into a Chosen One & It Could Be Bad for the Future
content: One Piece just might have turned Luffy into a true chosen one, and it could ruin how the rest of the series plays out in the future. One of the best elements across nearly 30 years of Eiichiro Oda’s One Piece run has been the fact that Luffy has entered in a new age of piracy meant to disrupt the world.
author: ComicBook

title: Studio Chromato, Studio Colorido, Shingo Yamashita Produce New Pokémon Short About Wartortle
content: The Pokémon Company began streaming a new " POKÉTOON " anime short on Wednesday. The short is titled "Kameil to Natsu no Tsuzuku" (Wartortle and the Ongoing Summer). The short follows a boy named Rikuto who visits his grandmother on an island at the end of summer. There, he meets a Wartortle.
author: ANN

title: ReZero’s Studio Has a New Isekai Anime Coming This Fall – Watch the Trailer
content: Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- has been in the midst of its biggest season of the anime to date this year, and the studio behind it has revealed they have a new Isekai anime franchise kicking off its own run later this Fall.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Cheat Fuyo' Reveals Additional Staff, Second Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Asa Rokushima 's Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
author: MyAnimeList

title: Chainsmoker Cat Anime Casts Yumi Hara
content: The staff for the television anime of Nyan Nyan Factory 's Chainsmoker Cat ( Yanineko ) manga announced on Wednesday that Yumi Hara will join the anime's cast as Yani Neko's mother Shizue Satō. The character will appear in the anime's seventh episode on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: New Pokémon Short Anime Directed by Shingo Yamashita Released
content: A new POKÉTOON short anime titled Wartortle and the Continuation of Summer premiered on the official Pokémon YouTube channel on August 12. Shingo Yamashita directed the short, with animation production by Studio Chromato and Studio Colorido.
author: Anime Corner

title: Netflix Confirms Controversial Live-Action Anime Adaptation Will Return
